summary: DC statehood advocates are highlighting recent events and ongoing efforts to advance the cause, including staff expansion at DC Vote and renewed commitments from elected officials. The advocacy community is drawing connections between federal intervention in the District and the need for greater local autonomy and self-governance. Without statehood, D.C. does not control its own National Guard and cannot refuse the deployment of other states' troops within its borders.

articles.title: VIDEO: Senator Slotkin Commits to Making DC Statehood a Top Priority
